name: gizza-ai/image-crop
summary: Crop a rectangular region from an image fetched by URL.

tool.description: Crop a rectangular region from an image. Coordinates are in pixels with (0,0) at the top-left corner. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call).

height.description: Height of the crop rectangle in pixels.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

width.description: Width of the crop rectangle in pixels.

x.description: Left offset of the crop rectangle in pixels.

y.description: Top offset of the crop rectangle in pixels.
